title: Authentic
slide_intent: Teach communicators to recognize the value of an observed personal moment. Specific relationships give a reader something concrete to believe and remember.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can ground its accounts of change in people and communities that participate in the movement.
demonstration: Two people in pale blue shirts lean toward each other and smile. The copy emphasizes grassroots participation and everyday stories of achievement.
practical_value: Choose a personal moment and supply enough context to explain what it means to the people involved.

content_islands.name: Photographic example
content_islands.spec: Use the photograph nearly edge to edge, keeping the two faces and their close gesture clear.

content_islands.name: Trait heading
